answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. Each agent must stake tokens, effectively transforming an abstract echo of digital identity into a tangible marble of financial security. To attack, a raven actor must amass majority control of the total supply, making the cost of creating fake nodes prohibitively expensive and economically irrational, as the resulting protocol degradation would directly erode their staked collateral.
